title: Acoustics & soundproofing
summary: Private boardrooms and cabins, calmer open offices and studio-grade isolation where it counts.
intro: Good acoustics make rooms private and offices calm. We design and build sound insulation for boardrooms and cabins, absorption for open floors and meeting rooms, and full isolation for studios, choosing materials that work as well acoustically as they look.

points.title: Private conversations
points.text: Partitions, doors, seals and glazing built to stop speech carrying between rooms.

points.title: Calmer open offices
points.text: Wall panels, ceiling clouds and baffles that cut echo and background noise.

points.title: Clear calls
points.text: Meeting rooms treated so microphones pick up voices, not the room.

points.title: Studio-grade isolation
points.text: Room-within-a-room construction for recording and production studios, as in our studio for A.R. Rahman.

includes: Ceiling clouds, baffles and acoustic ceilings
Noise control for equipment and services

faqs.question: Can an existing meeting room be soundproofed?
faqs.answer: Usually, yes. We find where sound is escaping, whether through the partition, the ceiling void, the door or the glazing, and treat those first.

metaDescription: Acoustics and soundproofing for boardrooms, cabins, open offices and studios in Mumbai: acoustic partitions, panels, ceilings and isolation.
